latest_release.name: v2026.11.09
latest_release.body:
This security release fixes server environment disclosure through JqAgent and bypasses of the enforced outbound proxy.  Upgrade installations that enable JqAgent or rely on `OUTBOUND_PROXY` to restrict users' outbound requests.

## Security fixes

- JqAgent now starts jq with an empty environment.  User filters can no longer read server environment variables through `env` or `$ENV`.  This affects installations with jq support enabled through `USE_JQ`.  [GHSA-3f56-748g-q34j](https://github.com/huginn/huginn/security/advisories/GHSA-3f56-748g-q34j)
- Enforce `OUTBOUND_PROXY` for HTTParty, open-uri and directly built Net::HTTP connections, including JiraAgent and WeiboPublishAgent.  These paths previously bypassed the configured proxy, allowing users to reach destinations it was intended to block.  The fix also covers related paths in StubhubAgent and default Scenario imports.  [GHSA-98rv-h5p4-9rgr](https://github.com/huginn/huginn/security/advisories/GHSA-98rv-h5p4-9rgr)

Thanks to [@akash111-hue](https://github.com/akash111-hue) for reporting both issues.

## Upgrade notes

No database migration is required for these fixes.  Update to `v2026.11.09` and restart Huginn's processes, or pull and recreate containers using the official release images.

If `USE_JQ` was enabled while untrusted users had accounts, treat secrets supplied through Huginn's environment as potentially exposed.  Rotate `APP_SECRET_TOKEN` and any affected database, SMTP, OAuth or other credentials.  Rotating `APP_SECRET_TOKEN` invalidates existing sessions.

JqAgent filters using `env` or `$ENV` now receive an empty object.  Pass intended inputs through the Agent's `variables` option instead.

Requests that previously bypassed `OUTBOUND_PROXY` may now fail under its destination policy.  Use an `http://` proxy URL for compatibility with open-uri clients; HTTPS destinations still use a CONNECT tunnel.  Normal routing is preserved when `OUTBOUND_PROXY` is unset.  See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/huginn/huginn/blob/v2026.11.09/UPGRADING.md#jqagent-environment-isolation-and-outbound-proxy-enforcement) and [outbound request configuration](https://github.com/huginn/huginn/blob/v2026.11.09/doc/manual/outbound-requests.md).

This release also refreshes Ruby dependencies.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huginn/huginn/compare/v2026.11.05.2...v2026.11.09
